text:
Maya: Quick question — for the compact per-route inspector, can we surface a 'quick bookmarks' row of saved views without blowing up the header? teams often have 30–50 route bookmarks and it becomes unreadable.

Kyle: We hit this before. Inline chips look neat but overflow and slow render. Idea: show top 3 chips + a chevron that opens a flyout with the rest. keeps header compact.

Jen: Chevron flyout ok, but discoverability is a risk for new users. Also: if each bookmark has a small telemetry preview (latency, p50), fetching those previews for every route will spike telemetry reads.

DevEx: API thought — reuse saved-query preview endpoint for the flyout to avoid duplicating work. Example: 
```
GET /console/routes/{route_id}/bookmarks?preview=true&limit=10
// returns basic meta + cached telemetry snapshot id
```
This returns lightweight preview tokens we can resolve lazily.

Sam: Can we lazy-resolve telemetry on hover? load preview blob only when flyout opens. That reduces backend load.

Anita: Hover-load helps, but teams open many flyouts during demo sessions. We should add sampling or TTL caching on previews. Proposal: preview TTL=5m and sample=1% for non-admin orgs.

Kyle: Sampling seems reasonable. Also, for admins we show full previews. We can gate via org feature flag and quota tier.

Maya: UX question: what do we show in a tiny preview tile? p50 latency, error rate, request rate? maybe last-deploy marker?

Jen: Keep it minimal: p50, errors%, and a tiny sparkline (last 1h). Clicking the tile opens the full saved view.

DevEx: Implementation note: sparkline should be an SVG with precomputed points from preview blob to avoid extra queries. cached blob format: {"points":"base64","meta":"..."} — small and serializable.

Sam: Re: quotas — previews should be metered against 'console telemetry fetches' not the main inference quota. Ops needs to track cost separately.

ops-bot: NOTICE: console-telemetry-fetches metric now available in infra dashboard (metrics.console.telemetry_fetches).

Anita: Good. We'll add a soft-limit: 10k preview fetches/org/day default, with ability to increase. Exceeding will return 429 with a helpful UI toast linking to console settings.

Luke: Rollout plan: feature-flag the flyout, enable for 10% of orgs this week, watch telemetry_fetches and UI latency. If stable after 72h, increment to 50%.

Maya: Sounds good. Action items: Kyle to mock flyout + chips, DevEx to wire preview endpoint and caching rules, Anita to set sampling + quota defaults, Luke to create rollout flag. I'll draft a short product note for customer-facing docs.

Kyle: I'll post a quick mock by EOD.

Jen: +1, I'll test discoverability with UX lab.

DevEx: I'll add the endpoint stub and put the preview metric behind feature-flag so we can measure.

Sam: I'll add an alert if preview fetches spike > 2x baseline during rollout.

Maya: thanks all! :rocket:

Jen: minor nit — include keyboard shortcut to open flyout (K) for power users.

Kyle: noted.

Maya: Closing thread, we'll sync tomorrow 10am to review mocks.
